NADIA: Missing Value-Aware DIA Proteomics Analysis

Source: R/NADIA-package.R
NADIA-package.Rd

A complete pipeline for differential protein expression analysis, with particular attention to the missing values that characterise data-independent acquisition. It covers the whole journey from the raw report to the interactive figure.

Details

The package is organised in four blocks:

Preprocessing

preprocess_spectronaut() for Spectronaut, preprocess_diann() for DIA-NN protein-group matrices, preprocess_tmt() and preprocess_lfq() for Proteome Discoverer. All four return the same proteomics_data S3 object, so the rest of the pipeline consumes them unchanged.

Processing

process_proteomics() coordinates normalization (13 methods), optional batch correction, imputation (20 methods, including the MAR/MNAR hybrids) and differential expression with limma or limpa.

Metrics and benchmarking

normalization_metrics(), imputation_metrics(), benchmarking_proteomics() and benchmarking_multiple() evaluate and rank method combinations.

Visualization

interactive plots with Highcharts (boxplot_highchart_list(), volcano_highchart_list(), pca_highchart_list()), static ones with ggplot2 and ComplexHeatmap (proteomics_heatmap()), and tables with reactable (results_list_reactable()).
